_meta.purpose: FRESH-DATA VALIDITY TEST (n=50 across 11 categories). The competitive set is derived per PRODUCT CATEGORY and held constant across its members, so the business is the only variable.
_meta.PRE_REGISTERED_PREDICTION: HIGH mental_advantage expected (owns transparent inclusive pricing)
_meta.LABEL_SOURCE: Published: 'Glasses from $98 with standard high-index aspheric lenses of any power included (no lens top-up), plus FREE Enhanced Progressive Lenses'
sources: Published: 'Glasses from $98 with standard high-index aspheric lenses of any power included (no lens top-up), plus FREE Enhanced Progressive Lenses'
_meta.authoring_note: FORM DATA reconstructed by the analyst from public sources. The LABEL is external and published; the form is thinner than a real submission. This is the known weakness of the test.

form.positioning_sentence: One price of S$98 including high-index lenses at any power, with progressive lenses free.
form.differentiator: One price of S$98 including high-index lenses at any power, with progressive lenses free. No top-ups and no hidden extras.
form.undercut_on: Our frames are mass-market rather than designer, and some concept stores are excluded from the free-progressive offer.
form.their_price_point: See the derived competitive set for the category price ladder.

tier_1_cheap_substitute.why: Lowest delivered price for a complete pair, lenses included.

tier_2_direct_set.why: Same product: a complete pair of prescription glasses.

members: OWNDAYS - the S$98-inclusive-lens standard, free progressives

tier_6_indirect.why: Changes demand shape rather than removing it.

derived_competitive_set._derivation_method: Derived from the PRODUCT CATEGORY (Eyewear: prescription spectacles), not the owner's list. Price spread in this category: wide (S$40-98+ with lenses). Tiers follow the eight-tier frame: default/no-purchase, cheap substitute, direct set, category incumbent (the rungs of the customer's mental ladder), adjacent crossover, indirect, and new entrants derived from public opening records.
